title: Steinfest at Tar Barrel
summary: Tar Barrel's five-day Steinfest runs from Wednesday 14 to Sunday 18 October in Mornington, with a special beer line-up and steins available at the venue. Check the organiser for the hours and current table arrangements for the day you plan to visit.
verificationNote: Tar Barrel's own What's On page returned HTTP 200 on 14 October 2026 and lists Steinfest for 14–18 October at 72 Watt Road, Mornington, with a venue table-booking action. Visit Mornington Peninsula's dated listing independently identifies the year as 2026 and says the event runs during normal trading hours. Neither source supplies event-specific daily session times. Stein and refill terms differ between the pages, so no price or availability is stated here.
editorVerdict: An easy Mornington beer-hall stop this weekend. Check Tar Barrel's trading hours and book a table if you're going with a group.
editorNote:
Tar Barrel is running its first Steinfest from Wednesday 14 to Sunday 18 October at its Watt Road brewpub in Mornington. The organiser advertises a special tap line-up and steins available to buy and fill at the venue.

The event runs during normal trading hours, but the event page does not set out separate session times for each day. Check Tar Barrel's current hours and table-booking terms before travelling, especially if you are bringing a group. Food and drinks are purchased separately; check the organiser's page for current stein terms.
